spec.title: Show action description in Run next action button
spec.context: The "Run next action" button in the VSCode task list view shows only a play icon with a static tooltip. Users cannot see what action will be performed without hovering or remembering the workflow sequence. The action text exists in the description field but gets truncated in narrow panels.

scope.in-scope: - Add ActionItem as expandable child of TaskItem in tree view - Display action label with task ID (e.g., "Scope task 003") - Display action description (e.g., "Research codebase and create spec") - Use green play icon to indicate actionable item - Make ActionItem clickable to trigger the action - Remove inline play button from task row
scope.out-of-scope: - Changes to the action definitions in task-actions.computer.ts - Changes to the terminal execution logic - Multiple actions display (only show primary/next action)

spec.requirements: - FR1: When a task is expanded in the tree view, an ActionItem shall appear as the first child (before file items) - FR2: The ActionItem label shall display "{ActionLabel} task {taskId}" (e.g., "Scope task 003") - FR3: The ActionItem description shall display the action's description text - FR4: The ActionItem shall use a green play ThemeIcon to indicate it is actionable - FR5: Clicking the ActionItem shall execute the action command in the terminal - FR6: Tasks with no valid next action (done status) shall not display an ActionItem - FR7: The inline play button shall be removed from the task row

files.file: Add ActionItem class extending vscode.TreeItem. Modify getChildren() for TaskItem to return ActionItem before FileItems.
Remove kanban.runNextAction from view/item/context inline menu. Keep command registered for ActionItem.command usage.
Minor adjustment to pass task info to ActionItem if needed. Current wiring may suffice.

patterns.pattern: Reference: apps/vscode/src/capabilities/tasks-view.capability.ts:177-207 ActionItem should follow same pattern: extend vscode.TreeItem, set command, iconPath, contextValue.
Reference: apps/vscode/src/capabilities/tasks-view.capability.ts:161-162 Use new vscode.ThemeIcon('play', new vscode.ThemeColor('charts.green')) for green play icon.
Reference: apps/vscode/src/capabilities/tasks-view.capability.ts:183-188 Set command property to trigger kanban.runAction with appropriate arguments.

research.engineering: Architecture follows Computer/Capability/Orchestrator pattern. ActionItem is a TreeItem so belongs in capability. Action logic remains in task-actions.computer.ts.
research.codebase: - TaskItem already receives nextAction from orchestrator via deps.getNextAction() - getChildren() returns FileItem[] for TaskItem - needs to prepend ActionItem - kanban.runNextAction command exists and can be reused via TreeItem.command
research.pitfalls: VSCode inline menu buttons have static titles from package.json - cannot be dynamic per item. Solution: move action to expandable child item instead.

spec.constraints: - Must use VSCode ThemeIcon and ThemeColor for theme compatibility - ActionItem must work with existing kanban.runNextAction command infrastructure - Cannot import vscode in computer files (architecture directive)

dependencies.internal: - TaskAction type from task-types.ts (already exists) - kanban.runNextAction command (already registered)
dependencies.external: None - uses existing VSCode TreeView API

risks.risk: Users may not realize they need to expand the task to see the action. Mitigated by keeping action text in description field as secondary indicator.

spec.open-questions: None - approach confirmed during scoping discussion.
